IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Human Services & Corrections (originally sponsored by Senator Benton)

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for the registration of sex offender or kidnapping offender e-mail addresses or other internet communication names or identities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the registration of sex offender emailaddresses or other internet communication names or identities; andadding a new section to chapter 9A.44 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9A.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In addition to the information required to be provided by a sexoffender or kidnapping offender who is required to register under theprovisions of RCW 9A.44.130, the county sheriff may request theoffender to provide his or her electronic mail address, internetcommunication name, or the uniform resource locator of any personal website created or operated by the person. The county sheriff shallforward any information obtained to the Washington state patrol asprovided in RCW 43.43.540. (2) The Washington state patrol may share information regarding aregistered sex offender or kidnapping offender's electronic mailaddress, internet communication name, or uniform resource locator ofany personal web site created or operated by the person with a businessor organization that offers electronic communication or remote p. 1 SSB 6210computing services for the purpose of prescreening users or forcomparison with information that is held by the requesting business ororganization. The requesting business or organization must agree notto further disseminate the information.
